_origin: Follows HMG-API core/hookpoints/framework.json@4fab437; 2026-11-04 additions only: d120037

framework.activity_thread.about: Android's per-process main thread; every app's start goes through it

framework.activity_thread.handle_bind_ap.about: an app process starts: HMG-API gives mods the app (LoadedApp)

framework.bcm_listener_stub.about: HMG-API answers its callbacks with a plain binder (only the ones it reads)

framework.bcm_listener_stub.heating.about: onRemoteTeleHeatingStatusChanged(steering wheel heat state, rear defogger state): sent on registration and on change; no getter has it

framework.bcm_service.charge_door.about: the charge door, as Kia Connect's remote command (false opens, per Charge Port Button)

framework.bcm_service.drv_seat_heat_opti.about: what the seat has: 1 heater with 2 levels (HEATER_ONLY_2STEP), 2 heater with 3, 6 heater and ventilation (EV6 front)

framework.bcm_service.drv_seat_heat_stat.about: driver seat climate step: 2 off, 3-5 ventilation low-high, 6-8 heater low-high (BCMConstants DrvSeatHeatState; the settings service answers -1 on the EV6)

framework.bcm_service.rl_seat_heat_optio.about: 1 on the EV6: 2 levels, no ventilation

framework.build_info.region.about: the head unit's region code (1 US, 4 Canada; see Car.region)

framework.context_impl.start_service.about: an app starts a service (the Wireless mod: no wired Android Auto for USB drives)

framework.datc_listener_stub.status.about: onDatcStatus(DatcStatus): the climate status, sent on registration and on change

framework.datc_status.ambient_f.about: outside temperature, Fahrenheit (what the cluster shows on a US car: 73.0 for 73 F)

framework.datc_status.ambient_state_c.about: 255: the Celsius value isn't valid (a US car fills Fahrenheit)

framework.dipo_mode.speech.about: 1: Siri is open (the voice button then goes to CarPlay only)

framework.factory_service.hide_consent_s.about: hides the startup notice; no known inverse

framework.gpm_manager.is_vr.about: Android Auto's assistant is open (the voice button then goes to Android Auto only)

framework.hev_flag.display_soc.about: state of charge as shown, 0.5% steps

framework.hev_service.batt_cond_station.about: battery conditioning: "routed to a charging station" (2,3 start; 0,0 stop), as the navigation sends

framework.hev_service.hev_status.about: one HEV value by its HEVFlag

framework.hkmc_loader.about: loads the car's own framework jars in system_server

framework.hkmc_loader.automotive_service.about: system_server's loader for automotive-service.jar (the car services, key dispatch)

framework.hscan_service.about: the telematics CAN readings (tm_hscan_service, com.hkmc.ext.hcan library)

framework.hscan_service.steering_angle.about: raw steering angle: signed 16-bit, 0.1 degree (Steering Arcade's, checked on a car; getSasAngleVal gives degrees but its left-turn form is unseen)

framework.io_bridge.connect.about: a socket connects (HMG-API's over-the-air update block)

framework.micomdata_callback_stub.about: HMG-API's MICOM watch extends it (compiled against core/runtime/stubs)

framework.micomdata_service.about: the car's raw MICOM data service: per-category frame callbacks (HMG-API only listens; its send method isn't mapped)

framework.micomdata_service.register.about: frames of one category (CID) to a callback: onEvent(cid, funcH, funcL, data)

framework.mode_key_dispatcher.about: the car's key dispatcher (automotive-service.jar, in system_server): WindowManagerService.interceptKey hands it every key

framework.mode_key_dispatcher.intercept_.about: every key once Android is up, from the key policy's dispatch step (the queueing step calls it only before boot): (focus, action, flags, deviceId, keyCode, scanCode, metaState, repeatCount, 0); negative: the key is used up. ModeManagerService.interceptKeyBefore* aren't called on 260507

framework.mode_manager_service.about: the car's mode and key service (automotive-service.jar, in system_server)

framework.mode_manager_service.intercept.about: every key, first: (focus, action, flags, deviceId, keyCode, scanCode, metaState, repeatCount, policyFlags); -1 drops it

framework.navigation_cluster.about: Hyundai/Kia's API to the instrument cluster and HUD (navigation data)

framework.navigation_cluster.update_lane.about: lanes to the cluster/HUD as raw bytes (Android Auto's lane format)

framework.pgs_service.request_guide_line.about: rear camera guide lines: 1 off, 2 on

framework.regulation_manager.about: the car's driving restriction (video and the like while moving)

framework.regulation_manager.show_popup.about: the car's own "not while driving" popup

framework.regulation_manager.status.about: 1 while the driving restriction is on

framework.regulation_service.status.about: 1 while the driving restriction is on

framework.resources.get_drawable.about: HMG-API answers its own resource ids (launcher tile icons)

framework.runtime.about: the VM's runtime: native library loading

framework.runtime.load_library.about: System.loadLibrary(name) lands here, with the caller's class loader (its dependencies load too)

framework.service_manager.get_service.about: a system service by its registered name

framework.system_properties.get_int.about: reads a system property (HMG-API never sets ro.* ones)

framework.system_service.gear_p_status.about: 1 when the gear is in P

framework.system_service.parking_brake_s.about: electronic parking brake status (2 with it on, EV6 2026-10-31; getParkingBrakeStatus stays 0 on the EV6)

framework.turn_list.about: one upcoming turn in the cluster's turn list

framework.usm_manager.about: the owner's settings (USM): units and the like

framework.usm_manager.distance_speed_uni.about: the owner's distance unit: 0 km, 1 miles

framework.usm_service.seat_heat_driver.about: driver seat heat step: 2 off, 6 low, 7 medium, 8 high (Cold-start Heat, on a car)

framework.usm_service.seat_heat_rear_lef.about: rear left seat climate step (as the front ones)

framework.vr_service.wheel_heat.about: steering wheel heat, 1 on 0 off: what "turn on the heated steering wheel" sends

framework.window_manager_service.interce.about: HKMC's key entry: the key policy's dispatch step hands it every key once Android is up and it passes the key to the car's key dispatcher; negative: the key is used up. A key put back with InputManager.injectInputEvent comes through here again
